fixed: Six staff posts, activation/hearing/compliance, 1329 audience, demographics, response, physical parameters, no added LEDs or barriers, and final-40/10-second rule. Only manager messages differ.
pairing: New seed resamples all audience and stochastic streams; identical seed paired across policies.
selection: Prefer complete policies, then lower mean full-house exterior clearance; assess <=180 reliability and paired uncertainty. If differences are unclear, prefer the simpler coherent fixed-message policy. No capacity or response retuning.
interpretation: Comparison of four prespecified candidates, not global optimization. Intervals conditional on the model; selecting a winner from this sample is not independent confirmation.
comparisonIntervals: Paired t, with Bonferroni simultaneous 95% intervals over the six candidate pairs; fixed-message preference applies if its adjusted interval against the mean winner includes zero.
